name: Helmut Lang
why: The 1990s minimalist's name, now a Fast Retailing label built around the Wardrobe jean and the plain tee; no store of its own in the US.
origin: Founded in 1986 in Vienna, Austria (made-to-measure studio 1977-1984 per MAK CV); first HELMUT LANG collection shown in Paris, 1986. Brand site says only "Austrian designer" by Helmut Lang.

craft_evidence.owned: no evidence: about page makes no factory or atelier claim; PDPs give third-country garment manufacture (Vietnam, Portugal, China, India, Peru, Turkey); Fast Retailing MSS 2025 describes sourcing from suppliers, no owned Helmut Lang factory
craft_evidence.makers: no: no PDP names a factory or workshop (148 styles read via product data and 6 rendered PDPs)
craft_evidence.mills: no: PDPs give fabric production country (e.g. Italy, Japan) and copy says "Italian denim" on 12 styles, but no mill is named
craft_evidence.madein: 142 of 148 men's clothing styles state the finished-garment manufacturing country (Materials & Care block; most also give fabric, weaving, dyeing and finishing countries); 6 state none. Vietnam 87, Portugal 40, China 8, India 4, Peru 2, Turkey 1 (by style)
craft_evidence.heritage: dated, not placed on brand site: about page says "established in 1986 by Austrian designer Helmut Lang"; MAK Vienna CV places the made-to-measure business in Vienna 1977-1984 and the first collection in Paris 1986; founder left 2005
craft_evidence.process: no: about page states principles (silhouette, proportion, materiality); PDPs give fabric names and a few finishing notes (garment dye, pintuck, distressing) but no account of how product is made
craft_evidence.reasoning: Helmut Lang names no maker and no mill and claims no owned facility; its product pages do state the manufacturing country on 142 of 148 men's styles (mostly Vietnam and Portugal), plus fabric origin countries. The founding is dated (1986) but the brand site does not place it or document any process. That is a stated-country house: 2.

ownership.owner: Fast Retailing Co., Ltd. (Japan): Helmut Lang New York LLC is a wholly owned subsidiary of Fast Retailing USA, Inc., itself wholly owned by Fast Retailing Co., Ltd. (FR Group Modern Slavery Statement 2025). It is a sister company of Theory LLC, not a Theory subsidiary; in Japan the brand is sold by Link Theory Japan Co., Ltd.
